meta.name: code-review
meta.description: Use when asked to review a PR, MR, branch, or diff, audit changed files, or check code quality.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审查代码变更，发现潜在问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常需要审查团队代码
copy.tagline_en: Review code changes and find potential issues
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly review team code

howto.what: 当你要审查代码时，Claude 会按流程检查每个变更文件，评估代码质量、测试覆盖等，最后给出批准或修改建议。可选在线发布评论。
howto.when: 当你要求审查 Pull Request、Merge Request、分支或 diff，或要求审计变更文件、检查代码质量时触发。

say.note: Claude 将分析所有变更并给出结构化反馈。

say.text: 检查这个分支的代码质量。
say.note: Claude 会验证分支并逐文件检查。

say.text: 审计这些变更文件是否合规。
say.note: Claude 会检查文件位置、命名、逻辑等。

howto.what_en: When asked for a code review, Claude performs structured analysis on each changed file, checks quality, test coverage, etc., and gives approval or change requests. Optionally posts comments online.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to review a PR/MR/branch/diff, audit changed files, or check code quality.

say_en.note: Claude analyzes changes and gives structured feedback.

say_en.text: Check the code quality on this branch.
say_en.note: Claude validates branch and inspects files.

say_en.text: Audit these changed files for compliance.
say_en.note: Claude checks location, naming, logic, etc.
